device.model: X110TS / X110TSE (the universal English "UNI ENG" build, "UNI RETA PVR")
device.type: DVB-S2 HD twin-tuner PVR satellite receiver with CI+ (Conax, Irdeto and Viaccess card slots named in the main code)
device.soc: ALi M3606 (the main-code chunk's version "M3606 2Tuner", the seecode chunk's "M3606 SEE"; the main code is the SDK's "M3602 HD STB" / "S3602 HD STB" platform build, SDK4.0ba.8.0_Combo)
device.family: M3602 (chips/m3602.py), matched by the main-code chunk's version
device.demod: internal (NIM_S3501_0 / NIM_S3501_1 for the two satellite tuners; the combo SDK's MxL101 terrestrial driver, NIM_MXL101_0 / _1, and NIM_COFDM_0 are in the build as well)

image.version: 1.4.0C PVR UNI ENG (main-code chunk 111000000003002 "M3606 2Tuner"; Application 1.0.0@SDK4.0ba.8.0_Combo_20120530, HDMI_ALI_E_120522_1; the SEE's uLibcore 1.1.5a@SDK_20111126 built 2012-05-31 by lanny.sun)
image.layout: bootloader 0x000000 (DVBS2---0.1.0), HDCPKey 0x01FE00 (1.0.1), maincode 0x020000 (chunk "111000000003002" M3606 2Tuner, LZMA 0x13D72E bytes -> 5.8 MB), seecode 0x180000 (M3606 SEE, LZMA 0xC9381 -> 2.6 MB), Radioback 0x280000 (1.0.0), keydb 0x28FF80 (1.0.0), defaultdb 0x2A0000 (1.1.0), userdb 0x2BFF80 (1.0.0, 0x140070 bytes) -- the whole 4 MB flash

source.site: satedu.cba.pl (a mirror of the official download)
source.note: The manufacturer's USB update ("Software Patch") Software_Patch_X110TS_X110TSE_1.4.0C_PVR_UNI_ENG_2015-05-04.rar (the .abs alone); fetched 2026-10-11 from the mirror's Opticum / INNE folder.

simulator.note: As the M3602 family (chip ID 0x3602, 2026-10-11): the bootloader runs from RAM (timer interrupts in its code at 0x81E8xxxx, 40 M instructions in 2.5 minutes) and prints nothing but the first byte -- the M3606 bootloader's wait for its SEE co-processor, as with the Cabletech URZ0086 (run_dump_urz0086_see_start.py); the application does not start.

desc: The official 1.4.0C PVR update (2015-05-04) of the Opticum X110TS / X110TSE twin-tuner satellite PVR, the universal English build: an ALi M3606 image like the Cabletech URZ0086's, with the SEE co-processor's program in a seecode chunk and a keydb chunk, on a 4 MB flash.

The application is the SDK 4.0 combo line of 2012 (SDK4.0ba.8.0_Combo_20120530): two S3501 satellite front ends plus the MxL101 terrestrial driver, Conax / Irdeto / Viaccess CA and CI+ ("Conax ITI CIPLUS CAM"), USB recording with a PVR manager, OTA by timer; the "UNI RETA PVR" (universal retail) model name.
